greeting: Well hello there, fellow pixel-pusher and code conjurer!
introParagraph: This week's 'Release Radar' is pinging with a mix of thoughtful accessibility improvements, crucial security patches, and even a dash of AI magic. While the fixes kept things stable, a certain calendar plugin decided to make things *really* interesting, proving that even a quiet week can have its standout stars. Let's dive into what's keeping our WordPress ecosystems humming (and sometimes, thinking for themselves!).

highlights.title: Sugar Calendar Lite 3.15.0
highlights.summary: Hold onto your event hats! Sugar Calendar just dropped 'Gia AI assistant,' letting you describe and create events via chat. It can also update existing events and answer questions about registrations and sales, making event management smarter and way more conversational.

highlights.title: Charitable 1.8.13.1
highlights.summary: Kudos to Charitable for baking in significant accessibility improvements across their donation forms, from better field labelling to visible keyboard focus indicators. This release ensures that giving back is easier and more inclusive for everyone, which is always a win in our book.

highlights.title: WPCode 2.4.0
highlights.summary: WPCode tightened up its safe mode security, ensuring that only users with snippet management capabilities can load the site with snippets disabled. This is a subtle but important tweak that enhances control and prevents unauthorized tampering, keeping your custom code safer.

highlights.title: Easy Digital Downloads 3.7.1.1
highlights.summary: EDD refined its Square integration, now completing orders only after Square confirms the payment is fully processed. This robust improvement ensures greater transactional accuracy and reliability for your digital product sales.
